_comment: Canonical measured numbers for the essaymaster paper. Case-study corpus = the Gerbil repo (/Users/shenron/Code/gerbil, HEAD=docs/paper-two-column), mined 2026-08-25 by a read-only agent; every block records the exact command. 'TODO' values are unsourced and surface as \todo{} in the tex.

case_study.provenance: read-only git mining session 2026-08-25; commands recorded per block below

corpus.provenance: git log --format='%H|%ad|%s' --date=short -- paper/ docs/gpu-engine/paper.md docs/research-paper-plan.md docs/paper-ablation-plan.md (HEAD-only; --all gives 47). Caveat: the 4 earliest commits (2026-03-11/12) are engine feat: commits touching the engineering reference doc, not the LaTeX paper; the LaTeX paper begins 2026-06-23 (f6ef90a).

commit_timeline.provenance: per-date counts aggregated from the 41-commit HEAD-only corpus list (same git log command as 'corpus')

decode_progression.window: the LaTeX paper's lifetime, 2026-06-23 (f6ef90a) to 2026-08-10 (be48302), ~7 weeks
decode_progression.provenance: gerbil git show f6ef90a: paper.tex abstract headline '145 tok/s Dawn M4 Max'; be48302 subject 'refresh decode-throughput progression to 347.3 tok/s kept peak'. The March engineering-reference doc carried only a projected 100-180 tok/s, so the progression is scoped to the LaTeX paper's lifetime, not the full case-study window. Verified by review pass 2026-08-25 (finding #E1).

ledger_growth.provenance: derived from todo_history rows below: 258 -> 498 total rows between 2026-06-23 and 2026-08-10 (~6.9 weeks); ~150 rows/month over the ledger's lifetime. Corrected from an unledgered ~50/month figure by review finding #E2.

todo_history.provenance: git log --follow -- paper/results/measurements.csv (8 versions); per sha: git show <sha>:paper/results/measurements.csv parsed with python3 csv.reader (285 rows contain quoted commas, so naive comma counting miscounts); todo = rows whose is_todo field is the string 'TODO'. NOTE semantics (review finding #E3): total_rows INCLUDES the todo_rows; sourced rows = total_rows - todo_rows (242 -> 490). Cross-checked against the build's own 'N curated rows (M TODO)' output at HEAD.

review_evidence.finding_lenses_never_used: #C (citations), #H (honesty) — no such ids appear anywhere in the log
example_subjects: paper: qualify causal claim in abstract+contributions (review #E1/E3/E4)
paper: reframe head-to-head as same-base-model native-format ... (review #E1-E7,#D1,#D2)
paper: TTS status ... + Limitations honesty pass (review #A1,#D2)
review_evidence.provenance: corpus git log subjects+bodies piped to grep -Ei '#(E|D|A|C|H)[0-9]|review'; bodies added nothing beyond subjects

snapshot_head.provenance: at gerbil HEAD 2026-08-25: python3 csv.reader over paper/results/measurements.csv (498 data rows, 8 with is_todo=='TODO'); grep -c '^@' paper/refs.bib; wc -l paper/paper.tex; grep -o 'todo{' paper/paper.tex | wc -l; ls paper/figures/*.svg | wc -l; mdls -name kMDItemNumberOfPages paper/paper.pdf

build.corpora_cleaning_example: gemma corpus: 504 rows kept, 29 adversarial/failed dropped (logged by the build)
build.provenance: time (cd gerbil/paper && ./build.sh) run once 2026-08-25; succeeded, 401.6 KiB PDF; n=1, warm cache — indicative, not a benchmark

sync_lag.provenance: for consecutive paper-commit pairs (last 15): git rev-list --count prev..curr and same with ':(exclude)paper' ':(exclude)docs/gpu-engine/paper.md' ':(exclude)docs/research-paper-plan.md' ':(exclude)docs/paper-ablation-plan.md'. UPPER BOUND: a commit touching both paper and code counts as non-paper.

plan_docs.provenance: wc -l on gerbil docs/research-paper-plan.md and docs/paper-ablation-plan.md; grep '^| ' with 'arXiv:' / -i 'repo only' over plan table rows

this_paper.pipeline_run: first end-to-end essaymaster run (mine -> plan -> scaffold -> data -> figures -> draft -> build), executed by a Claude Code agent 2026-08-25
this_paper.provenance: this session; the 7 = Knuth 1984, Olah 2017, Kluyver 2016, Lethbridge 2003, SWE-agent, SWE-bench, AI Scientist (web-verified 2026-08-25); remaining refs.bib entries are repo/site-only by design
